description: Test a list of paths against a .gitignore file's contents, following git's matching rules: a leading `!` negates a pattern, a trailing `/` restricts a pattern to directories, and a pattern with no interior `/` can match at any depth. The last matching pattern wins. Does not replicate git's rule that a negation cannot re-include a file whose parent directory was already excluded.

paths.description: Relative, forward-slash separated paths to test; use a trailing "/" to mark a directory

name: test_gitignore_patterns
